## 3 Occult Books for Beginners to Start Your Esoteric Journey
### 2. [The Secret Teachings of All Ages](https://bookscouter.com/book/9780486471433-the-secret-teachings-of-all-ages-an-encyclopedic-outline-of-?type=buy) [![The Secret Teachings of All Ages](https://bookscouter.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/The-Secret-Teachings-of-All-Ages.jpg)](https://bookscouter.com/book/9780486471433-the-secret-teachings-of-all-ages-an-encyclopedic-outline-of-?type=buy)
[by Manly P. Hall.](https://bookscouter.com/author/hall-manly-p)

Self-published by Hall in 1928, _The Secret Teachings of All Ages_ is precisely what its name indicates—a dense, extensive, and comprehensive guide to arcane mysteries and occult knowledge.

It spans millennia of human history and covers dozens of different cultures and traditions.

### [![The Hermetica](https://bookscouter.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/The-Hermetica.jpg)](https://bookscouter.com/book/9781585426928-the-hermetica-the-lost-wisdom-of-the-pharaohs?type=buy) 3. [The Hermetica: The Lost Wisdom of the Pharaohs](https://bookscouter.com/book/9781585426928-the-hermetica-the-lost-wisdom-of-the-pharaohs?type=buy)
[by Timothy Freke](https://bookscouter.com/author/freke-timothy) & [Peter Gandy](https://bookscouter.com/author/gandy-peter)

_The Hermetica_ is an analytical and curated selection of key extracts from the _Corpus Hermeticum_ and other essential writings of Hermes Trismegistus. These extracts are explained and rewritten to retain their original wisdom and poetry while making them more accessible to enthusiastic readers, making it a quintessential introductory piece for occult enthusiasts.
